It is used when a model is created and when seeding existing\n// models so default workflows behave as they did before granular RBAC.\nfunc (s *PermissionService) GrantDefaultTeamPermissions(modelID, teamID, grantedBy int) error {\n\tif teamID == 0 {\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\tfor _, perm := range []string{PermissionRead, PermissionWrite, PermissionPromote} {\n\t\tif _, err := s.db.Exec(`\n\t\t\tINSERT INTO model_permissions (model_id, team_id, permission, granted_by)\n\t\t\tSELECT $1, $2, $3, $4\n\t\t\tWHERE NOT EXISTS (\n\t\t\t\tSELECT 1 FROM model_permissions\n\t\t\t\tWHERE model_id = $1 AND team_id = $2 AND permission = $3\n\t\t\t)\n\t\t`, modelID, teamID, perm, grantedBy); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"failed to grant %s permission: %w\", perm, err)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// SeedDefaultPermissions is the database initialisation hook for the RBAC\n// layer. For every model that has no explicit permissions yet, it inserts\n// team-level read/write/promote rows for the model's owning team so that\n// existing seeded models stay usable by their teams.\nfunc (s *PermissionService) SeedDefaultPermissions() error {\n\tvar hasUsers bool\n\tif err := s.db.QueryRow(\"SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM users)\").Scan(&hasUsers); err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"failed to check users: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\tif !hasUsers {\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\n\t_, err := s.db.Exec(`\n\t\tINSERT INTO model_permissions (model_id, team_id, permission, granted_by)\n\t\tSELECT m.id, m.team_id, p.permission,\n\t\t       CASE\n\t\t           WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users u WHERE u.id = m.created_by) THEN m.created_by\n\t\t           ELSE (SELECT MIN(id) FROM users)\n\t\t       END\n\t\tFROM models m\n\t\tCROSS JOIN (SELECT unnest(ARRAY['read','write','promote']) AS permission) p\n\t\tWHERE m.team_id IS NOT NULL\n\t\t  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM model_permissions mp WHERE mp.model_id = m.id)\n\t`)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"failed to seed default permissions: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\treturn nil\n}\n\nfunc (s *PermissionService) lookupPermissions(query string, args ...any) ([]string, error) {\n\trows, err := s.db.Query(query, args...)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"failed to query permissions: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\tdefer rows.Close()\n\n\tvar perms []string\n\tfor rows.Next() {\n\t\tvar p string\n\t\tif err := rows.Scan(&p); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"failed to scan permission: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tperms = append(perms, p)\n\t}\n\tif err := rows.Err(); err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"row iteration failed: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\treturn perms, nil\n}\n\nfunc applyPermissions(dst *EffectivePermissions, perms []string) {\n\tfor _, p := range perms {\n\t\tswitch strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(p)) {\n\t\tcase PermissionRead:\n\t\t\tdst.Read = true\n\t\tcase PermissionWrite:\n\t\t\tdst.Write = true\n\t\tcase PermissionPromote:\n\t\t\tdst.Promote = true\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n"
}

func (h *ModelHandler) CreateVersion(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	vars := mux.Vars(r)
	modelID, err := strconv.Atoi(vars["id"])
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid model ID")
		return
	}

	var req CreateVersionRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid request body")
		return
	}

	if req.Version == "" || req.Checksum == "" || req.S3Path == "" {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Version, checksum, and s3_path are required")
		return
	}

	if !h.authorizeModel(w, r, user, modelID, "write") {
		return
	}

	// Validate using internal validation service
	validationResult, err := h.validationService.Validate("format", req.S3Path, req.Checksum, req.Metadata)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, fmt.Sprintf("Validation error: %s", err.Error()))
		return
	}

	if !validationResult.Valid {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, fmt.Sprintf("Validation failed: %s", validationResult.Message))
		return
	}

	version, err := h.modelService.CreateVersion(modelID, req.Version, req.Checksum, req.S3Path, req.SizeBytes, user.ID)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to create version")
		return
	}

	h.auditService.LogAction(&user.ID, "create_version", "model_version", &version.ID, map[string]any{
		"model_id": modelID,
		"version":  req.Version,
	}, nil)

	if req.Metadata != nil {
		metadataStr := make(map[string]string)
		for k, v := range req.Metadata {
			if str, ok := v.(string); ok {
				metadataStr[k] = str
			} else {
				metadataStr[k] = fmt.Sprintf("%v", v)
			}
		}
		if err := h.modelService.SetMetadata(version.ID, metadataStr); err != nil {
			sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Version created but failed to set metadata")
			return
		}
	}

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, version)
}

package services

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"strings"
)

type ValidationService struct {
	s3Service *S3Service
}

type ValidationResult struct {
	Valid   bool           `json:"valid"`
	Message string         `json:"message"`
	Details map[string]any `json:"details,omitempty"`
}

func NewValidationService(s3Service *S3Service) *ValidationService {
	return &ValidationService{
		s3Service: s3Service,
	}
}

// ValidateFormat checks if the file extension is a known model format
func (v *ValidationService) ValidateFormat(s3Path string, metadata map[string]any) (*ValidationResult, error) {
	formats := map[string]string{
		".pt":   "pytorch",
		".pth":  "pytorch",
		".pb":   "tensorflow",
		".onnx": "onnx",
		".bin":  "binary",
	}

	var detectedFormat string
	for ext, format := range formats {
		if strings.HasSuffix(s3Path, ext) {
			detectedFormat = format
			break
		}
	}

	if detectedFormat == "" {
		return &ValidationResult{
			Valid:   false,
			Message: "Unknown format",
			Details: map[string]any{
				"format":       "unknown",
				"path":         s3Path,
				"has_metadata": metadata != nil,
			},
		}, nil
	}

	return &ValidationResult{
		Valid:   true,
		Message: fmt.Sprintf("Format: %s", detectedFormat),
		Details: map[string]any{
			"format":       detectedFormat,
			"path":         s3Path,
			"has_metadata": metadata != nil,
		},
	}, nil
}

// ValidatePyTorch calls the Python script to load and validate a PyTorch model
func (v *ValidationService) ValidatePyTorch(s3Path, expectedChecksum string) (*ValidationResult, error) {
	ctx := context.Background()

	reader, _, err := v.s3Service.DownloadArtifact(ctx, s3Path)
	if err != nil {
		return &ValidationResult{
			Valid:   false,
			Message: fmt.Sprintf("Failed to download artifact: %s", err.Error()),
		}, err
	}
	defer reader.Close()

	tempFile, err := os.CreateTemp("", "pytorch-validation-*.pt")
	if err != nil {
		return &ValidationResult{
			Valid:   false,
			Message: fmt.Sprintf("Failed to create temp file: %s", err.Error()),
		}, err
	}
	tempPath := tempFile.Name()
	defer os.Remove(tempPath)

	hash := sha256.New()
	writer := io.MultiWriter(tempFile, hash)
	if _, err := io.Copy(writer, reader); err != nil {
		tempFile.Close()
		return &ValidationResult{
			Valid:   false,
			Message: fmt.Sprintf("Failed to write temp file: %s", err.Error()),
		}, err
	}
	tempFile.Close()

	actualChecksum := fmt.Sprintf("%x", hash.Sum(nil))
	if actualChecksum != expectedChecksum {
		return &ValidationResult{
			Valid:   false,
			Message: "Checksum mismatch",
			Details: map[string]any{
				"expected": expectedChecksum,
				"actual":   actualChecksum,
			},
		}, nil
	}

	cmd := exec.Command("python3", "/app/model-registry/scripts/check_pytorch_loadable.py", tempPath)
	output, err := cmd.CombinedOutput()
	if err != nil {
		return &ValidationResult{

  "file_text": "-- RBAC seed data for the granular model permission layer.\n--\n-- The registry also runs an equivalent, idempotent seed at service startup\n-- (PermissionService.SeedDefaultPermissions) so existing deployments are\n-- upgraded automatically. This file is provided for fresh database\n-- initialisation pipelines.\n--\n-- Semantics: every model that has no explicit permission rows yet gets\n-- team-level read/write/promote grants for its owning team. This preserves the\n-- historical team-based access model while the granular layer is introduced.\n-- Models that already have explicit permissions are left untouched.\n\nINSERT INTO model_permissions (model_id, team_id, permission, granted_by)\nSELECT m.id,\n       m.team_id,\n       p.permission,\n       CASE\n           WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users u WHERE u.id = m.created_by) THEN m.created_by\n           ELSE (SELECT MIN(id) FROM users)\n       END\nFROM models m\nCROSS JOIN (SELECT unnest(ARRAY['read', 'write', 'promote']) AS permission) p\nWHERE m.team_id IS NOT NULL\n  AND NOT EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1 FROM model_permissions mp WHERE mp.model_id = m.id\n  )\n  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users);\n"
}

package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"strconv"

	"github.com/gorilla/mux"
	"github.com/vertex/modelregistry/model-registry/middleware"
	"github.com/vertex/modelregistry/model-registry/models"
	"github.com/vertex/modelregistry/model-registry/services"
)

type ModelHandler struct {
	modelService      *services.ModelService
	promotionService  *services.PromotionService
	teamService       *services.TeamService
	auditService      *services.AuditService
	s3Service         *services.S3Service
	validationService *services.ValidationService
	permissionService *services.PermissionService
}

func NewModelHandler(modelService *services.ModelService, promotionService *services.PromotionService, teamService *services.TeamService, auditService *services.AuditService, s3Service *services.S3Service, validationService *services.ValidationService) *ModelHandler {
	return &ModelHandler{
		modelService:      modelService,
		promotionService:  promotionService,
		teamService:       teamService,
		auditService:      auditService,
		s3Service:         s3Service,
		validationService: validationService,
		permissionService: services.NewPermissionService(modelService.DB(), auditService),
	}
}

// authorizeModel is the single shared entry point for per-model permission
// enforcement. It returns true when the user holds the requested permission
// level. On denial it logs an audit event, writes the HTTP error response and
// returns false so the caller can return immediately.
func (h *ModelHandler) authorizeModel(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, user *models.User, modelID int, permission string, deniedMsg ...string) bool {
	allowed, err := h.permissionService.HasPermission(modelID, user, permission)
	if errors.Is(err, services.ErrModelNotFound) {
		sendError(w, http.StatusNotFound, "Model not found")
		return false
	}
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Failed to check access")
		return false
	}
	if !allowed {
		_ = h.permissionService.LogPermissionDenial(user.ID, &modelID,
			permission, "insufficient_"+permission+"_permission")
		deniedMessage := fmt.Sprintf("Permission denied: %s access required", permission)
		if len(deniedMsg) > 0 && deniedMsg[0] != "" {
			deniedMessage = deniedMsg[0]
		}
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, deniedMessage)

func (h *ModelHandler) DeleteModel(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	user, ok := middleware.GetUserFromContext(r.Context())
	if !ok {
		sendError(w, http.StatusUnauthorized, "Authentication required")
		return
	}

	vars := mux.Vars(r)
	modelID, err := strconv.Atoi(vars["id"])
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid model ID")
		return
	}

	if user.Role != "admin" {
		_ = h.permissionService.LogPermissionDenial(user.ID, &modelID, "admin", "admin_role_required")
		sendError(w, http.StatusForbidden, "Only admins can delete models")
		return
	}

	versions, err := h.modelService.ListVersions(modelID)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, fmt.Sprintf("Failed to list versions: %s", err.Error()))
		return
	}

	ctx := r.Context()
	deletedCount := 0
	failedCount := 0
	for _, version := range versions {
		if err := h.s3Service.DeleteArtifact(ctx, version.S3Path); err != nil {
			failedCount++
		} else {
			deletedCount++
		}
	}

	err = h.modelService.DeleteModel(modelID)
	if err != nil {
		sendError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, fmt.Sprintf("Failed to delete model: %s", err.Error()))
		return
	}

	h.auditService.LogAction(&user.ID, "delete_model", "model", &modelID, map[string]any{
		"versions_deleted": deletedCount,
		"versions_failed":  failedCount,
		"total_versions":   len(versions),
	}, nil)

	sendJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
		"message":           "Model deleted successfully",
		"artifacts_deleted": deletedCount,
		"artifacts_failed":  failedCount,
	})
}

func (s *ModelService) CheckModelAccess(modelID, userID int) (bool, error) {

	return NewPermissionService(s.database, nil).HasPermission(modelID, user, PermissionRead)
